B50.visual_intent: Two tracks. Top: one lone gate with a check; it greys out ('missed') and a terracotta dot slips through unchecked. Bottom: 'built in', three gates in the track, each with its check, and the terracotta dot is stopped at the first.
B50.motion_claim: The single gate fails and the dot slips; the built-in gates stop it.
B50.runner_up: Remotion/Manim row of timeline cards (one person vs a team)
B50.why: A person is never an icon, so fragility is drawn as a gate that stops working; the motion is the slip vs the catch.

B51.visual_intent: Workflow line ship-run-review-act; checklist, monitoring and handoff cards land on the first three stages; a ring asks where/by whom/seeing what stage by stage; the fourth slot is an empty ghost card with a terracotta dot, 'nobody', 'undefended gap'.
B51.motion_claim: The question-ring walks the line and stops on the stage with no insert.
B51.why: The claim is a gap in a sequence, so a line with a hole beats a card.

B52.visual_intent: Timeline before run / during run / before action: padlock closes on the prediction, record lines accumulate, magnifier over a state card; below, a ledger holds 'predicted', 'observed' is appended, a crossed arrow says no rewrite.
B52.motion_claim: Prediction locks, record grows, observation is appended, never written over.
B52.why: Rebuilds the three-phase workflow figure with its ordering as the motion.

B53.visual_intent: Four outlined tiles ASKED / DID / REPORTED / STATE: envelope, local screen with ghost envelope, big check ('reset completed'), server still holding the envelope. DID+REPORTED ring in ink, gap arrow with an X to STATE, terracotta dot; then a lens sweeps the four tiles.
B53.motion_claim: Report and local action match; the state does not; the lens passes over all four.
B53.why: Same four tiles as the first appearance, so the viewer recognises the running case; the lens carries 'every new lens'.

B54.visual_intent: Three cards: check+hazard, fluent lines+X, check+empty box; then a net with four stakes and three terracotta failure dots dropping onto it, 'supervisory, human'.
B54.motion_claim: The failures drop and the net catches them.
B54.why: Three claims in parallel read as three glyph cards; the catching net shows what the capacities do.

B55.visual_intent: Balance titled 'trust anyway?': 'cost of checking' vs 'cost of error'. The beam tips left, then right, settles slightly off level. A schematic chart (confidence tracking truth, labelled schematic) appears under 'change my mind'.
B55.motion_claim: The beam swings and never settles level; the chart shows what would flip it.
B55.why: A scale is the one picture where two costs weigh against each other and visibly stay unresolved.
